description: Returns what each trust's monthly trustee report (Form 10-D) said about one loan, month by month, for about the last year: the special servicer's comment facts with a short excerpt, resolution strategy, transfer and return dates, foreclosure, bankruptcy and REO dates, appraisal values and reductions, advances and modifications, and what changed from the previous report. Use it after get_loan to see what happened to a loan and what changed this month. Without a key it returns a notice that a key is needed.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

name: get_loan_servicer

WhatChanged.description: What the latest trustee report changed from the one before it.

comment.description: The special servicer's comment that changed this month, from the trust whose comment is longest.

comparedWith.description: Month (YYYY-MM) of the trust's previous report on file that the facts were compared with.

facts.description: The change facts for that month, one per distinct sentence; the same fact from several trusts (pari passu notes) is one entry listing each trust.

month.description: The newest report month (YYYY-MM, the month of the report's distribution date) any of the loan's notes has a row for.

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation getLoanServicer). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

asOf.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the loan database is as of: the as-of date of the nightly loans job.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

limits.description: Free plan only: URL of the page describing limits and plans.

message.description: Free plan only: sentence saying the trustee-report facts are not in this plan, with the limits URL.

months.description: Every report month on file for the loan, newest first.

month.description: Report month, YYYY-MM: the month of the trustee report's distribution date.

reports.description: One entry per note of the loan that a trust's report listed in its trouble tables that month (or that dropped out of them that month).

note.description: Fixed sentence saying where these facts come from (10-D Exhibit 99.1) and what reportHistory is.

onFile.description: Free plan refusal only: what is on file for the loan; the helper supports it but this operation passes none, so it is never sent here.

plan.description: Free plan only: the caller's plan, always "free" here.

proRequired.description: Free plan only: always true, meaning this answer needs a paid plan and carries no data.

reportHistory.description: For notes in trusts whose report is a Citibank statement: the past rows that the trust's latest report reprints from its appraisal reduction, modification and special servicing tables.

appraisalReductions.description: Rows of 'Historical Appraisal Reduction Detail', one per distribution date and piece.

assetNumber.description: The loan's number in the trust's asset file.

slug.description: The loan's page slug on cmbs.news.

url.description: The loan's page URL on cmbs.news.

whatChanged.description: What the newest month of trustee reports on file for this loan changed versus each trust's previous report.

title: What the trustee reports said about a loan
